response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY
), per_pair AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY mktnote
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_rate
  FROM per_pair
), above AS (
  SELECT p.avg_net_fee_rate, b.mean_pair_rate
  FROM per_pair AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.mean_pair_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS average_pair_net_fee_rate,
       AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - mean_pair_rate) AS average_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite's BINARY collation is used to enforce exact, case-sensitive text comparison of recordvault and orderslink; NULL values are skipped by AVG, including when either rate is missing.
